title: DEMI CHEF
resolution: Demi chef is a chef rank; cook also defensible. Both accepted.

title: Account Executive (AR / Construction / ERP / Saga 300 / Ubi)
resolution: Both accounts-clerk and assistant-accountant levels defensible. Both accepted.

title: ADMINSTRATIVE ACCOUNTS
resolution: A coded ledger clerk, B said title gives no clear duties. Genuinely ambiguous; clerk codes and NONE all accepted; excluded from the true no-match set.

title: Data Business Analyst
resolution: Data business analyst: business analyst or data analyst. Both accepted.

title: Accounts Payable Executive
resolution: Accounts payable executive: clerk or assistant accountant. Both accepted.

title: Video Editor
resolution: Video editor: multimedia/animator or video editor. Both accepted.

title: Social Media Content Creator
resolution: Social content creator: digital marketing or content writer. Both accepted.
